ui:help.en: Address of the Anthropic-compatible relay; requests go to <Base URL>/v1/messages. A trailing /v1 is removed.
ui:help.zh: Anthropic 兼容中转站的地址，请求发往 <Base URL>/v1/messages；末尾的 /v1 会被去掉。

ui:help.en: Key issued by the relay, sent as x-api-key. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ui:help.zh: 中转站发放的 Key，以 x-api-key 发送；加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。
